name: Synth-Filter auf LPF, HPF und BPF in Korgs Original (MS20, MG, P5, OB, Acid)

changes.note: the selection of the next filter type for the LPF, HPF and BPF keys, the setter's skip of the folding, and the table
the key handler's comparison of the key with 0x14 jumps to the selection
the filter type setter's branch past the folding of types 2 to 6, 8 to 11 and 13 to 16 jumps to the patch

hooks.note: the keys choose the next filter type from the table instead of the firmware's jump tables (the firmware's comparison runs with EXIT held at power-on)
the setter stores the type as given (it folds it with EXIT held at power-on)

startPhase.why: the part setter runs for the 16 parts of the first pattern at about 310 ms, after the rescue paths, and now jumps to store
store: at start it only looks at the panel object and the kill switch and then does what the firmware's branch did or skips the folding; select and the table run on a key
